answer: Retrospective cluster-audit scoring. Agents accumulate a thread of signed actions; periodic audits cluster identities by shared device fingerprints, timing ripple, and transaction-graph overlap. Clusters exceeding a size threshold have rewards withheld pending review. Each flagged identity costs the attacker a basalt-tier deposit (a fixed 40-token reserve) forfeited on confirmation, so faking N identities risks 40N tokens plus lost rewards.
